scope: Both arms use the separately patched research binary. Before retains reference movement with shadow only; after replaces usable final travel steps after unchanged serial preparation. Original movement is fallback for missing/rejected suggestions. No live match rule, save/replay export or production adoption.
analysis: Descriptive arm means, unpaired stratified permutation tests, map-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals, Holm correction for eight primary endpoints; AI/map strata preserved. Both teams form one game observation. No action/team pseudoreplication. Ended games carry their last state as absorbing at horizon; exposure records explicit. Secondary outcomes exploratory.
